title: pane run --worktree survives one failed git fetch
notes: Retro 2026-11-26: in the hermes session, pane run --worktree failed 9 times with 'session run failed: Command failed: git fetch origin master ... Permission denied (publickey)', a transient SSH failure, and the agent wrote retry loops by hand. The fetch is in src/main/actions/worktree/make.ts (~line 127). Retry the fetch once; if it still fails, cut the worktree from the local remote-tracking ref and print a warning that it may be stale, rather than refusing.
